# CMSIS-Core (vendored)

Source: [ARM-software/CMSIS_5](https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5) tag **5.9.0**

Copied from `CMSIS/Core/Include/`:

- `core_cm4.h`
- `cmsis_compiler.h`
- `cmsis_gcc.h`
- `cmsis_version.h`
- `mpu_armv7.h`

No STM32Cube / device packs — only Cortex-M4 core headers used with `bsp/include/stm32f405xx.h`.
